'''Alright''' (Thai: '''ออไรท์''' ''Alright'') is the 2017 opening song of the {{pmin|Thailand|Thai}} dub. It debuted in [[SM001]]. It uses the same footage as its corresponding Japanese opening theme, [[Alola!!]].
